incidents.name: MEV bot unprotected swap callback
incidents.notes: The MEV bot's PancakeSwap swap callback performs no caller or authorisation check, so anyone could trigger it through a WBNB/BUSDT pair swap and have the bot pay out its whole BUSDT balance.

sources.ref: onchain review: victim 0x8c2d4ed92badb9b65f278efb8b440f4bc995ffe7 created 2023-08-28T07:25:54Z by 0x761453712e163571c02208d8609ae234215e66bf, which is not the attack-tx sender 0x69e068eb917115ed103278b812ec7541f021cea0; 0 EIP-1967 Upgraded events on the victim before the incident; code age measured from deployment (onchain).
